addon.offerTitle: Lebih cepat di GPU NVIDIA kamu
addon.offerBody: Di GPU ini, model lokal biasanya berjalan lebih cepat dengan mesin CUDA daripada Vulkan: sering 10-70% lebih banyak token per detik, lebih besar lagi saat model tidak muat sepenuhnya di VRAM. Unduhan sekali saja, sekitar {{size}}.
addon.vulkanMeanwhile: Sementara itu Vulkan dipakai. CUDA mengambil alih saat model berikutnya dimuat.
addon.installedBody: Akan dipakai mulai pemuatan model berikutnya.
addon.driverBody: Perbarui driver NVIDIA kamu untuk memakai mesin CUDA yang lebih cepat. Terpasang: {{current}}, dibutuhkan: R{{min}} atau lebih baru. Sampai saat itu Vulkan dipakai.
addon.panelDesc: Mesin GPU tambahan, diunduh hanya saat kamu minta. Vulkan tetap sebagai cadangan.

redownload.label: Re-download the backend
redownload.description: Some core backend files are missing or corrupted — this usually means the download was interrupted or the archive was only partially extracted. Delete the backend and re-download it from Flint settings.

cuda.windows: Install the CUDA Toolkit{{version}} from NVIDIA. During installation, select "CUDA" components.
cuda.linux: Install the CUDA Toolkit{{version}} from NVIDIA. On Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-{{apt}}. On RHEL/Fedora: use the NVIDIA repo.

nccl.windows: Install NCCL from the NVIDIA Developer site. NCCL is used for multi-GPU collective communications.
nccl.linux: Install NCCL via the NVIDIA package repository. On Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. See the NVIDIA NCCL install guide for your distro.

cudnn.windows: Install cuDNN from the NVIDIA Developer site and place the DLLs alongside the application or in System32.
cudnn.linux: Install cuDNN via the NVIDIA package repository or download the tarball and copy libs to /usr/local/cuda/lib64.

vulkan.label: Vulkan Runtime
vulkan.windows: Install the Vulkan Runtime from LunarG. Your GPU driver may already include it — update your GPU driver first.
vulkan.linux: Install the Vulkan loader: on Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. On Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. On RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
